title: redact takes any word]: or word]= in prose for a bracketed secret key and replaces the text after it
goal: redact replaces a bracketed-key assignment (cfg['password'] = 'v', cfg["password"] = "v", headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer v') only when the key has its opening bracket and quote, so prose and markdown such as '[Secret]: see the docs for rotation', a '[password]: https://x.example.com/a' reference link and 'See [api_key]: the field list' stay whole. Found by the SP-g4mwrwsv review (gap 2): the bracket part of ASSIGNMENT makes the closing bracket optional and needs no opening one. test_redact.py's every-class test keeps its planted bracketed values and gains one prose case that stays whole (no new test id).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import redact as R;t="[Secret]: see the docs for rotation";o=R.redact(t);print(o);sys.exit(0 if o==t else 1)
